articles.title: Trump and Xi Share a Fancy Dinner and a Bald Eagle Statue
articles.summary: President Trump welcomed China's President Xi to the White House for a big state dinner. Trump gave Xi a sculpture of a bald eagle. Both leaders said they want peace and friendship, but experts say no big deals were made yet.

articles.title: Two Leaders, One Big Meeting: Trump and Xi Talk AI, Trade, and Taiwan
articles.summary: China's leader Xi Jinping visited the White House for the first time in over 10 years. He and President Trump talked about trade, AI, Taiwan, and Iran. One big deal: they agreed to keep a 'trade truce' going.

articles.title: Xi Visits Trump: Red Carpet, But Not Everything He Wanted
articles.summary: China's leader Xi Jinping met President Trump in Washington. Trump gave him a fancy welcome, but Xi didn't get everything he asked for. The two countries agreed to pause their tariff fight — but only until January.
